mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( user_id, trainer_id, gym_id, purpose, experience, height, weight, diet, exerciseCount_goal, address, latitude, longitude, NAME, goals, next_session, lesson_count, total_lessons, last_session, STATUS, age ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{trainerId}, #{gymId}, #{purpose}, #{experience}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{diet}, #{exerciseCountGoal}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{name}, #{goals}, #{nextSession}, #{lessonCount}, #{totalLessons}, #{lastSession}, #{status}, #{age} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, trainer_id, gym_id, purpose, experience, height, weight, diet, exerciseCount_goal, address, latitude, longitude, NAME, goals, next_session, lesson_count, total_lessons, last_session, STATUS, age FROM MEMBER WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, user_id, trainer_id, gym_id, purpose, experience, height, weight, diet, exerciseCount_goal, address, latitude, longitude, NAME, goals, next_session, lesson_count, total_lessons, last_session, STATUS, age FROM MEMBER WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.trainer_id, m.gym_id, m.purpose, m.experience, m.height, m.weight, m.diet, m.exerciseCount_goal, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.NAME, m.goals, m.next_session, m.lesson_count, m.total_lessons, m.last_session, m.STATUS, m.age, u.email, u.nickname, u.profileImg, u.role, u.email_verified, u.provider FROM MEMBER m JOIN USER u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = #{email} AND u.is_deleted = 0
SELECT m.id FROM MEMBER m JOIN USER u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = #{email} AND u.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET trainer_id = #{trainerId}, gym_id = #{gymId}, purpose = #{purpose}, experience = #{experience}, height = #{height}, weight = #{weight}, diet = #{diet}, exerciseCount_goal = #{exerciseCountGoal}, address = #{address}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, NAME = #{name}, goals = #{goals}, next_session = #{nextSession}, lesson_count = #{lessonCount}, total_lessons = #{totalLessons}, last_session = #{lastSession}, STATUS = #{status}, age = #{age} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.trainer_id, m.gym_id, m.purpose, m.experience, m.height, m.weight, m.diet, m.exerciseCount_goal, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.NAME, m.goals, m.next_session, m.lesson_count, m.total_lessons, m.last_session, m.STATUS, m.age, u.email, u.nickname, u.profileImg, u.role FROM MEMBER m JOIN USER u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.id DESC

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.trainer_id, m.gym_id, m.NAME, m.goals, m.next_session, m.lesson_count, m.total_lessons, m.last_session, m.STATUS, m.age, u.email, u.nickname, u.profileImg, u.role FROM MEMBER m JOIN USER u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.gym_id = #{gymId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.id DESC
